reviews.title: Favortism
reviews.text:
I am a user of this app, and it has its good points and its bad points about it. The good points is the great unknown artist that this app has on it throughout the world. The bad points is how Rapfame runs the app. Some rules that the app has just does not make sense to me whatsoever.  In my opinion it shows major favoritism, and also only caters to certain genre of Hip Hop music. The app is more in favor of a younger generation, instead of what it should be, an app for all of Hip-Hop from all over, no matter the age limit.  Also there should be more rules in place to showcase talent from artist, instead of only just making a fast cash grab for the app.  Also they need to hire more people, because the app over look talent, and leave music on red, and the only way to get noticed is by paying $20 bucks to get a feature. Thats not good.  This app
and the people that run it has to do better all across the board.  Favoritism rules with an iron fist.
